summary: Shengfeng Development Limited filed a Form 6-K to announce a 1-for-15 reverse stock split of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective September 8, 2026. The split proportionally increases par value from US$0.0001 to US$0.0015 per share, with fractional shares rounded up. VStock Transfer, LLC serves as exchange agent. The company's Class A shares will continue trading on Nasdaq under symbol SFWL with a new CUSIP. This corporate action is routine and not a special situation; it may be intended to meet Nasdaq listing requirements but is not a transaction category.
